item.title: Listening to the Brain: How Binaural Beats Alter Neural Rhythms
item.description: At PULSAR Radio, sound is not just entertainment—it’s a tool for exploration. Beyond playlists and broadcasts, we’re interested in how sound interacts with the brain itself. Can carefully designed tones actually shape neural activity? item.description: What makes a band like Radiohead so endlessly fascinating? For some, it’s the restless experimentation—from the grunge guitars of Pablo Honey to the icy electronics of Kid A.
